selection: 1,000 additional distinct titles from the requested gospel artists and related gospel singers and choirs. Existing titles and aliases, recording versions, identified hymn arrangements, medleys, translations and secular repertoire excluded.
limitations: These are source references, not recording-verified transcriptions. Community charts are condensed. ChordU records contain only the ordered simplified practice sequence publicly reported by that source, not full gospel arrangements or section maps. Popularity dates are recorded only where dated evidence was found; 1999–2026 popularity has not been established for every entry.
